summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for any Woot rights-dependent, public-display, alert-expansion, affiliate, or advertising decision. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and keep Woot outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot documents API access but not redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public use, storage, derivatives, listings, prices, and data mining. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, privacy, consent, vendor, incident, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally where it adds no new data collection, rights-dependent use, monetization claim, credential, permission, dependency, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because source rights, field permissions, retention/deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Progress is evidenced by the existing API, terms, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert permissions, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request to Woot. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory and route counsel-required gaps.

Fleet compliance and data-quality disposition: conditional for ordinary bounded growth, not a reason to block growth solely because telemetry is incomplete. Technical compliance is a baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors exist; unavailable values remain unavailable, not zero. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecasts, or causal lift. Retain existing measurement, attribution, remediation, and repair-or-close work; create no duplicate legal proposal or change request.

Private and parked launch decisions: searchwoot.com remains private pending completion of the four-task launch checklist, human-counsel review, security/accuracy/measurement gates, and owner disposition. The scaffold factory candidates remain parked/private preview-only because execution-owner verification and launch-readiness evidence are not present; no publish, deploy, DNS, analytics configuration, monetization, or spend is authorized. The next evidence action for each is dated execution-owner verification plus preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence.

Keep searchwoot.com private and Woot outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Continue the existing consolidated read-only launch-readiness evidence bundle; do not expose, monetize, expand alerts, or change production.
